C-FRONTEND-REACT-ROUTER-20261119.Summary: Replace query-string navigation (?page=editor&campaign=ID) with react-router-dom path routes.
C-FRONTEND-REACT-ROUTER-20261119.Problem: The app navigates with a hand-written useUrlParam hook, producing URLs like /?campaign=214554&page=editor instead of readable paths.

Goals.Goal: Routes: / (campaign creator), /editor (editor without a campaign), /campaigns/:campaignId (editor of one campaign); unknown paths redirect to /.
Header navigation uses NavLink; "Открыть в редакторе", the created-campaigns table and the editor campaign picker navigate to /campaigns/:campaignId.
Legacy links /?page=editor&campaign=ID and /?page=editor|create redirect to the new paths.
The hand-written shared/lib/url-state.ts is removed; routing lives in the FSD app layer, pages stay router-agnostic (props in, callbacks out).

Constraints.Constraint: No backend or API contract change; nginx and Vite already fall back to index.html for any path.
Tests are banned; evidence is make gate-frontend, gate-compose and a browser check.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No data loaders/actions, no lazy route splitting, no change to page content.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Opening /campaigns/214554 directly (also on the nginx build at :8080) shows that campaign in the editor; browser back/forward works between pages.
make gate-frontend and grace lint exit 0.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Gate output and browser navigation check on the Vite dev server and the nginx build.

Assumptions.Assumption: Requested by the user in chat on 2026-11-19 ("подключи React Router Dom").
